newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates end sharply down around 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates end sharply down around 18 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates closed lower on Monday at around 18 percent, compared with Friday's close of 20.25/21.00 percent, traders said.
"Only small banks were taking up some money and they could not soak up excess liqudity from the market, " said Krisztina Hortobagyi of Creditanstalt.
Overnight rates opened at 21.50 percent, but quickly began to plummet and went as low as 18 percent.
One trader said he expects the rates to remain low on Tuesday.
"People are ususally afraid of the year-end and make provisions in good time, thus excess liqudity will remain for tomorrow," said Geza of West LB Hungaria.
